About

Operations built on process, not firefighting.

I'm a Senior Operations & Project Management professional with 10+ years of experience across operations, logistics, and client delivery — including 9 years in the US-based logistics and warehousing industry. My work sits at the intersection of field coordination and data — planning execution end-to-end, managing client escalations, and building the Excel VBA, Power BI and Power Query systems that turn raw activity into decisions leadership can act on.

I've led as Assistant Manager of Operations for a 24/7 warehouse & delivery environment, supervised teams of 10+, and I'm currently working as a Project Lead at Inter-Prompt Global — acting as the primary link between clients, field engineers, and internal teams.

Projects

Three systems built to replace scattered spreadsheets and status calls with a single source of truth — executive revenue reporting, multi-client ticket operations, and real-time SLA monitoring.

PROJECT 01 — BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE
IP Global Revenue Board
Revenue Analytics Excel Automation Executive Dashboard

A centralized Revenue Management Dashboard built to give senior management a real-time, visual overview of business performance — no more waiting on manually assembled Excel reports.

Automates the transformation of monthly Excel data into graphical insights covering overall revenue, client-wise revenue, margin % and value, month-over-month comparisons, and AP/AR — deployed as a live tool leadership now uses for monthly revenue and profitability analysis.

PROJECT 02 — OPERATIONS & FINANCE
Customer-Made CRM — 2 Key Clients
Supabase SLA Monitoring AP/AR Reporting

Custom CRM platforms built from the ground up for two key client accounts — consolidating ticket management, field engineer scheduling, SLA monitoring, AP/AR and reporting into one centralized system, backed by a Supabase database built and managed end-to-end.

Interactive dashboards cover monthly performance, margin analysis, ticket status, FE details and client coverage, including a world map visualization giving management a clear read on geographical reach — while the operations team runs day-to-day activity on top of the same historical data used for monthly profitability analysis.

01 One system replacing scattered spreadsheets for 2 key client accounts

Global coverage map Financial overview Client dashboard
PROJECT 03 — SLA & RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
MicroLand SLA Breach Tracker
JavaScript Automated Alerts Email Workflow

A real-time SLA monitoring and resource allocation tracker built to proactively manage client tickets and minimize SLA breaches — SLA calculations run automatically off each ticket's required completion time, city, country and time zone, giving a live countdown to deadline.

An automated alert workflow notifies the resource team the moment a new ticket lands and follows up on open ones, with an interactive email-based "Completed / Not Yet" action that syncs status straight back to the tracking portal — plus recurring 4-hour alerts on unresolved tickets for continuous visibility.

01 Live SLA countdown per ticket's city, country & time zone
02 Email status actions synced automatically to the tracker
03 Recurring 4-hour alerts cutting potential SLA breaches
